content:
anya: Pushed a quick Figma prototype of a Permission Grid + new invite drawer. Looking for quick UX + a11y sanity check before I hand to eng. Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz (preview)
mike: saw it, nice. Quick Q: are we keeping the old roles shorthand label under the grid or removing it? lots of customers mention it in support.
samira: +1 on keeping it, but technically we can't load full role descriptions inline for huge orgs — need virtualized rows. can the design show an ellipsis with hover tooltip instead?
anya: yeah I mocked an inline ellipsis + tooltip on hover, and a details flyout for keyboard/assistive use.
josh: frontend note: virtualized rows mean row height must be fixed; variable content (long role names) will be clipped. prefer tooltip + a dedicated detail panel instead of row expansion.
lexa: a11y nits: 1) ensure tooltip content is accessible via keyboard (focusable) and announced by SR when opened. 2) contrast of the permission chips is low at small sizes — need to hit 4.5:1 for body text.
anya: noted. I'll update colors and add a focusable tooltip pattern. Also thinking about making the SSO control not a single toggle but an explicit radio group: "SSO optional / SSO required" so users understand enforcement vs hint.
mike: agreed on radio group — toggles imply simple on/off, enforcement has more policy implications.
samira: backend implication: enforcement equals blocking non-SAML logins. Need to surface a warning modal explaining affected users and sessions before flip. not a blocker for the UI, but we'll need an API flag and a job to migrate sessions.
josh: keyboard flow for the invite drawer: ensure the primary action (Send invites) is disabled until at least one recipient is valid. Also trap focus in the drawer but restore focus to previous element on close. small snippet we use:
```
drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false')
drawer.focus()
// on close
drawer.removeAttribute('aria-hidden')
previousEl.focus()
```
lexa: for audit timeline navigation (the new left rail mini-timeline) — please ensure timeline updates are read with a live region when filters change. Also add visible focus state to timeline items; voiceover users need to know which period is active.
anya: I added a compact timeline with live-region id in the mock. The tricky bit is heavy orgs where timeline buckets show thousands of events — we should instead show summary counts and a "view events" button that opens paginated results.
mike: decision proposal: show summary buckets in timeline (with counts), timeline items keyboard-focusable, and "view events" -> opens audit modal with paginated list.
samira: ok from infra side. we'll implement server-side pagination and cursor. for counts we can fetch an aggregated endpoint.
anya: design action items: 1) swap SSO toggle -> radio group and add warning copy, 2) update chip colors to meet contrast, 3) make tooltip focusable and keyboard operable, 4) timeline -> buckets + view events modal copy. I'll drop updated frames by EOD.
josh: dev tasks: assign keyboard focus + trap, add aria-live for timeline, hook up pagination API. will create tickets after frames land.
lexa: will run quick a11y pass on updated frames (contrast + SR announcements). also recommend adding role="status" on the migration warning modal while it's processing.
figma-bot: New version uploaded by anya — 1717805200 — "Permission grid: radio SSO + timeline buckets" :white_check_mark:
anya: thanks all. if no more blockers I'm going to iterate and hand off to eng tomorrow. :rocket:
